experiment: E1h consistent restart from the exact resting state

config.start: exact fixed point (intrinsic.true_rest); fallback 300-s burn-in if not ok

EXPRESSIBLE*: rescaled L1 == frozen-gate slow current, both from the fixed point, < 1e-6 (fold 0)
PROTOCOL_DEPENDENT: L1 (zero + 30-s burn-in) vs L1* gap/noise >= 0.1 or |held-out dFEVE| >= 0.05 on some fold
SLOW_GAIN_SURVIVES: B beats L1*, CI lower bound > 0
UNDERFIT_L1: A beats L1*, CI lower bound > 0
ADAPTATION_DYNAMICS: B beats A, CI lower bound > 0
VALID: on L1*-generated null data neither A nor B beats L1* (CI lower <= 0)
